description: Create or update a slide of a presentation. Slides are shared across all variants. Required: presentation_id. Pass slide_id to update an existing slide, omit to create. Optional: slide_type (title|content|video|solution|questions), position, title, content (structured object; content.page_image_url = optional image of the WHOLE rendered slide page, used on cue cards), html (free HTML, exception), image_url, footer. When an existing slide's title/content/html changes, ALL its per-variant notes are marked stale (needs re-check/translation). Returns { slide_id, notes_marked_stale }.

content.description: Structured slide content; content.page_image_url = image of the whole rendered slide

html.description: Free HTML for the slide (exception, prefer content)

position.description: Position of the slide in the deck

slide_type.description: Kind of slide: title, content, video, solution or questions

name: upsert_slide
